payload.description_html: Anatomy of the Koumpiodontosuchus aprosdokiti holotype skull (IWCMS 2012.203–204), revealed by high resolution micro-computed tomography (microCT). All images in left lateral view. Top: reconstructed skull, with each bone shown in a distinct color. Middle: Internal cranial features, including neurovascular canals (red), brain endocast (blue), cranial nerves (yellow), and pneumatic cavities (green). Bottom: Emphasized dentition, including the roots embedded in the jaws. For more details, see "Re-evaluation of the Wealden crocodyliform Koumpiodontosuchus Sweetman et al., 2015: new osteological and neuroanatomical data from micro-computed tomography resolves a phylogenetic dispute"
